# Classic Resurrection (concept by Kerblabs)

> Auto restoration and service center in Grove City, Ohio. This is a free concept site, not the official site. Official: https://www.classicresurrection.com

## About
- Restoration and service for classics, resto-mods, muscle cars, street rods and pro-touring cars
- Hand-crafted parts where none are available; custom details for hot rods
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/classic_resurrection/

## FAQ
- Where? Grove City, Ohio.
- Prices? Not published; quoted per project.
- Contact? Contact form on classicresurrection.com, or Instagram.
